ticket:
Title: Sync Trips to the cloud
Body: Save every Trip to our server so a Traveller can open it on another phone.

findings.message: Conflicts with the offline-first constraint: all data stays on the device and no account or network is needed.
findings.evidence: REQ-5: All data is stored on the device.

questions: REQ-5 forbids server storage. Should this ticket be dropped or should the PRD change first?

ticket:
Title: Warn on long Day Plans
Body: Given a Day Plan with total Duration of 961 minutes, When it is shown, Then a warning appears and the plan can still be saved.

findings.message: Implements REQ-7; link it in the spec.
findings.evidence: REQ-7: warning above 960 minutes, not blocking
